decided: With sign-off off, the AI's plain account of what a change built is still written, but no separate reader checks it, and the brief says it was not checked.
alternatives: a separate reader checks the account on every change, named as a third exception in G0
why: Nothing changes by default, so G0 needs no new exception; the account is checked whenever a sign-off depends on it.

defines.definition: a fresh AI session given the architecture doc, each record with what it points at, and a fixed task, which checks that each record can be understood without knowing the work
